title: Algebraic extensions of separably closed fields
statement: Let $K$ be a separably closed field [def-pc-separably-closed], and let $L/K$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] which is algebraic, meaning that every element of $L$ satisfies a nonzero polynomial over $K$. Then $L$ is separably closed, and $L/K$ is purely inseparable [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. No finite-dimensionality hypothesis is imposed.
